_comment: APPROVED by the founder on 2026-10-22. NOT YET ACTIVE for customers: first verify provider prices, fees and
margins (docs/CREDIT_PRICING_PROPOSAL.md, section 9), then apply with: flask --app wsgi aszda pricing-apply pricing.approved.json --yes
Rule used: every generation earns at least 262.5 credits per US$1 of provider cost, which keeps a
50% gross margin after the 3.8% Paystack card fee even at the cheapest credit price sold (Studio Max, $0.00792/credit).
Provider prices and their sources are in docs/CREDIT_PRICING_PROPOSAL.md. USD subscription and package prices are not changed here.
